descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S19 「发送，然后改一个任务再发一次：两条记录，第一条不变」 Send, then change a task and send again: two records, the first unchanged

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U8 Each send leaves the same record as Handoff: sender, recipient and timestamp, persistent and retrievable on both sides（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr; TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • T2 The recipient opens the received list from their own account, read-only; the tasks do not become the recipient's own tasks（TFA-92585 AC 6；TFA-92585 How it works 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr; TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home（UAT TC-07；UAT 3.3；TFA-92585 AC 12） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Sender has sent the S01 list (Hospital) and the S02 list (Nursing Home) to the recipient once each

When Sender ticks 'Order PT evaluation' done and sends the Hospital list again; ticks 'Wound check with nursing' done and sends the Nursing Home list again; recipient opens all four records, reloads, opens the older ones again

Then Two records per context on each side, each with its own time; each first record still shows the later-ticked task as pending, each second record as completed; both survive a reload

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U8 (each send is its own record) and the Handoff rule that the recipient receives the text as sent (TFA-92586 AC 4). Record counts from handoffs:list after the run (4 task-list rows from {sender}; oracleRules 6). Same-patient pairs only (Q5): second Hospital record ['Follow up blood cultures', 'Order PT evaluation'] (Ben pending before Ben completed), second Nursing Home recor …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S19 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-07.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：dev。
